item.title: Error catalog
item.description:
nityAnanda/ nithyAnanda

Bad examples for followers:

  • Numerous sex scandals,
  • dancing on father’s corpse.
  • entrapment of whistle-blowers

Hilariously wrong claims

  • “abhinavagupta inspired shankarAchArya”
  • “sun delayed his rising for me.”

sadhguru jaggi vAsudev

Sanskrit etymology mistakes

  • Confusing: ‘kala’ (‘kāla’, “time” or “dark”), ‘kali’ (‘kālī’, the goddess), and ‘khali’ (khālī/ख़ाली/خالي, “empty”) - NM, YT.
  • “Shiva ’literally’ means ’that which is not’”. JM_FB, IMG.

Science errors

Wrong claims about science, scientists and scientific facts.

NM12

““When a woman delivers twins, one male and one female, one breast will produce one type of milk and the other breast will produce another type of milk.” TW
